name: Landmark Packaging Inc

about:
Landmark Packaging Inc. was founded in 2012 in Aurora, Colorado, by Mark, Paul, and Jeff. The trio set out to serve small and medium-sized businesses in the Rocky Mountain region with custom packaging solutions at affordable prices.

The company operates as both a manufacturer and distributor of packaging materials, offering boxes, bags, labels, janitorial supplies, and personal protective equipment. Its 48,000-square-foot warehouse supports digital printing, custom box and label production, container fabrication, and fulfillment services such as labeling, polyethylene bagging, stretch film, shrink wrap, tape, and bubble wrap.

Landmark focuses on Colorado-based small and medium enterprises across various sectors, providing stock and custom packaging for shipping, storage, and retail needs. Customers include local manufacturers, distributors, and service businesses that require flexible, cost-effective packaging.

The founders’ original vision — maintaining a focus on smaller businesses while expanding capabilities — remains the company’s guiding principle. Landmark emphasizes affordable pricing, custom digital printing, and a growing range of packaging options to help its clients succeed.
